graph.title: Big Bling Wheelie (8658-1)

edges.method: air scoop clip on handle bar
air scoop clip on handle bar
bracket attached sideways to front of red plate (studs)

notes: Fix: p20 no longer lists p13 in rests_on. p13 is a plate at layer 2 (top at layer 3), but p20's bottom is at layer 5 (on top of the 3-plate-tall bricks p5 and p6), so they don't touch. p13 only sits on p8 in the gap between the two bricks.

The booklet drawings are small and several pieces (dark gray vs black plates, the front grille sub-assembly, curved bricks) are ambiguous; positions and some rests_on relations are best-effort reconstructions.

Step numbering: steps 1-5, then the grille/headlight sub-assembly (step 6), then booklet steps 6-9 as steps 7-10. The single black plate in sub-assembly box 1 (p10) is counted inside booklet step 6 (step 7).
Chassis occupies x1..7, y0..1; the curved hood pieces overhang to x0 and are approximated on the same grid.
Page 2 combines with set 8655 and uses parts not in this piece list, so it is ignored.
Front grille sub-assembly (p21, p11, p1, p31, p32), scoops, wheels, tyres and sticker sheet are sideways/pinned/clipped, so position is null and they are connected via other_joins.
Which of the 2x2 black plates is p10 and which is p11, and the exact placement of p12/p13, are assumptions.
